propositions: The enrich drain advisory lock is held across LLM calls (437s and 131s observed), causing per-write spawned drain children to skip with lock-held status and creating a single-flight bottleneck with a standing backlog of ~1,046 entries
The drain must be restructured into three phases (collect/enrich/finalize) where the advisory lock is released before LLM calls, enabling concurrent drainers bounded by a small guard (2-3 drainers)

Stale-at-writeback entries must be detected by content-hash revalidation during finalize; if the ticket changed since claim, the emit is skipped and the entry is re-enqueued with immediate retry (soak 0)
The batch cap must be bounded by a lease-derived formula (max(1, lease_ttl_s // 40)) to prevent lease expiry mid-run and unbounded LLM spend on a single write

The effective batch cap is raised from 5 to 20 (bounded by the lease formula) and the collect window is reduced from multi-minute exclusive holds to 1.5-2.9s with up to 3 concurrent drainers, increasing throughput from ~5 items per hold to ~60 items per hold window
